note: The page's Lab tab. Matt 2026-11-12: EVERYTHING being tested is listed here (live-tracked paper tests and the Researcher's forward tests). Each entry's numbers come live from its summary file. Remove an entry when its test is closed.

tests.title: 1 PM price
tests.rule: Hard Rock 1%+ better than the other books' middle price at the 1 PM price read, graded at the 1 PM price. Counting from Nov 9.
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit. Even then it comes to Matt: 1 PM picks are off until he says go. Updated each morning.
tests.name: 1 PM price
tests.plain: Bet shots at the 1 PM price when Hard Rock beats other books by 1%+
tests.why: Hard Rock's early price is sometimes better than the market's. We grade at that price.

tests.title: Hard Rock moved since 1 PM: follow it
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL1f-follow).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Hard Rock moved: follow
tests.plain: After Hard Rock changes a price since 1 PM, bet the same way
tests.why: Hard Rock may have news, and the move is right.

tests.title: Hard Rock 1%+ better, other books agree closely
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL3a).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Bargain, books agree
tests.plain: Bet when Hard Rock pays 1%+ more and the other books all agree
tests.why: If every other book agrees, the bargain is more likely real.

tests.title: Hard Rock 1%+ better, other books disagree
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL3b).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Bargain, books split
tests.plain: Bet when Hard Rock pays 1%+ more and the other books disagree
tests.why: When books disagree, a good price may just be noise. We check.

tests.title: Hard Rock moves alone: bet against it
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL4a).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Hard Rock alone: go against
tests.plain: When only Hard Rock moves a price, bet the other way
tests.why: A move nobody else made may be a mistake. We bet the opposite side.

tests.title: Exchanges as the fair price
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL5).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Exchange prices
tests.plain: Use betting exchange prices to find bargains
tests.why: Exchanges have almost no markup, so their price is a good guide to the real odds.

tests.title: Hard Rock's line differs from the other books
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 24, counting from Nov 9. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (LL6).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Different line at Hard Rock
tests.plain: Bet when Hard Rock's line is different from the other books
tests.why: A different line can hide a better chance to win.

tests.title: Sharp books vs soft books split
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM2a).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Sharp vs casual books
tests.plain: Follow the sharp books when casual books disagree
tests.why: Sharp books (the ones pros use) are usually right.

tests.title: Sharp vs soft split, 2%+
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM2b).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Sharp vs casual, big gap
tests.plain: Same as above, only when the gap is 2%+
tests.why: A bigger gap should be a clearer signal, with fewer picks.

tests.title: Gap holds from 90 to 45 minutes
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM3a).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Gap lasts 90 to 45 min
tests.plain: Bet when a price gap stays from 90 to 45 minutes before the game
tests.why: A gap that lasts is likelier to be real than one that flashes.

tests.title: Gap confirmed at 45 minutes
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM3b).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Gap still there at 45 min
tests.plain: Bet when a price gap is still there 45 minutes before the game
tests.why: Checking again later filters out gaps that close fast.

tests.title: Game total moved, props didn't
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM4).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Game total moved
tests.plain: Bet shots when the game total moved but player prices did not
tests.why: If the game's expected scoring changed, a player's price may be behind.

tests.title: Hard Rock shifted its line: follow it
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM5a).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Hard Rock line shift: follow
tests.plain: When Hard Rock shifts its line, bet the way it moved
tests.why: Hard Rock may know something.

tests.title: Hard Rock shifted its line: bet against it
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 25, counting from Nov 10. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (MM5b).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Hard Rock shift: go against
tests.plain: When Hard Rock shifts its line, bet the other way
tests.why: A line shift may be an overreaction. We bet the opposite side.

tests.title: Hard Rock moneyline off the market: follow the market
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 26, counting from Nov 11. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (NN2fa).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Winner: follow the market
tests.plain: Pick the game winner the other books favor when Hard Rock disagrees
tests.why: The books together are usually more right than one book. Research only, game winners are not picks.

tests.title: Hard Rock moneyline off the market: follow Hard Rock
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 26, counting from Nov 11. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (NN2fb).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Winner: follow Hard Rock
tests.plain: Pick the game winner Hard Rock favors when it disagrees with others
tests.why: Hard Rock may see something the others miss. Research only, game winners are not picks.

tests.title: Exchanges move, Hard Rock hasn't
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 26, counting from Nov 11. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (NN4).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Exchanges moved first
tests.plain: Follow the betting exchanges when they move and Hard Rock has not
tests.why: Exchanges are sharp. Hard Rock may be slow to catch up.

tests.title: Whole market moves, Hard Rock hasn't
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 26, counting from Nov 11. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (NN5).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Market moved, Hard Rock not
tests.plain: Follow the market when most books moved and Hard Rock has not
tests.why: If everyone else moved, Hard Rock's price is probably out of date.

tests.title: Bet against soft-book moves
tests.rule: Shots, research only. Run 26, counting from Nov 11. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (NN6).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Against casual-book moves
tests.plain: Bet against a move that only casual books made
tests.why: If casual books move and sharp books stay put, the move may be wrong.

tests.title: Points: Hard Rock 5%+ better than Pinnacle
tests.rule: Points, research only. Last read before the game: Hard Rock's price is 5%+ better than Pinnacle's fair price, price -200 to +120. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Points: Hard Rock bargain
tests.plain: Bet points when Hard Rock pays 5%+ more than Pinnacle's fair price
tests.why: Pinnacle is the sharpest book. If Hard Rock pays more, that is a bargain.

tests.title: Shots line 5%+ below average (under)
tests.rule: Shots, research only. The line sits 5%+ below the player's rolling shots average (5+ games): bet the under. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Shots line below average
tests.plain: Bet UNDER when a player's shots line is well below his average
tests.why: We check if a line far from a player's usual is a bargain on one side.

tests.title: Shots line 5%+ above average (over)
tests.rule: Shots, research only. The line sits 5%+ above the player's rolling shots average (5+ games): bet the over. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Shots line above average
tests.plain: Bet OVER when a player's shots line is well above his average
tests.why: We check if a line far from a player's usual is a bargain on one side.

tests.title: Facing a backup goalie (shots over)
tests.rule: Shots, research only. The opposing goalie is confirmed and is not his team's most-started goalie: bet skaters' shots over. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Facing a backup goalie
tests.plain: Bet shots OVER when the other team plays a backup goalie
tests.why: A backup goalie may change how teams shoot. Books may be slow to adjust.

tests.title: Skater rest: 3+ days off over, back-to-back under
tests.rule: Shots, research only. 3+ days of rest bets the over, 0-1 days bets the under. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
tests.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Skater rest days
tests.plain: Bet shots OVER after 3+ days off, UNDER after 0 to 1
tests.why: Rest may change how much a skater shoots. Books may not price it fully.

queued.title: Skater rest, reversed
queued.rule: Shots, research only. The opposite of the rest test: 3+ days off bets the under, 0-1 days bets the over. Counting from Nov 21. Full rule: research/HYPOTHESES.md (Run 28).
queued.gate: Passes only at 300 graded with a clear profit and beating the close.
